title: Pediatric_Spindles_HI: analysis code, main figures and tables of "Anterior Fast Spindle Duration is Associated with Both Hypopnea Burden and Attentional Performance in Children"
description: The analysis pipeline, and the drawing scripts, layouts and summarized source data that re-render the main figures (Figures 1–6), with the main tables (Tables 1–3) of the paper. Participant-level and raw data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
